_comment: Castle upgrades (GameCommand.UPGRADE_CASTLE, scripts/game_state.gd, scripts/castle_upgrades.gd; tools/balance_sim.py reads the same file). One row per upgrade, in order: price (gold, wood), lives added to the castle (and to its repair ceiling) and the cumulative ARMOR after the upgrade: every enemy that gets through takes max(1, base_damage - armor) lives. Same prices in every mode (campaign, record run, daily, co-op); nothing is saved between battles.
